issuing_orgs: National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders
synopsis: The objective of this Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) is to continue to support laboratories that constitute a collaborative network, the NIDCD National Human Ear Resource Network, to serve as a national technological resource for auditory and vestibular researchers to use human inner and middle ear tissues for a range of basic and clinical studies to advance knowledge and treatment of auditory and vestibular disorders.
title: National Resource Network for the Study of Human Auditory and Vestibular Disorders (U24 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
